Cc: procurement@alphamart.com
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: AlphaMart onboarding — PO number + spend cap setup

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We're ready to move forward with Redwood for production. A couple of procurement items to get the vendor record live on our side:

- We need the official Purchase Reference (PO-like identifier) you will issue so our AP team can link invoices.
- Confirm how spend caps are applied — we have an initial quarterly limit of $75k and need the ability to request increases.
- There's one line-item mismatch in the onboarding form we attached (subscription tiers vs. token buckets). Can you advise how that maps to your PO/line schema?

Attached: AlphaMart_Onboarding_Form.pdf (contains suggested line items and billing contact).

Can you send the provisional PO/ref and the mapping template your finance team prefers? We aim to raise the requisition by EOD Tuesday.

Best,
Amit
Procurement Lead, AlphaMart
attachments: AlphaMart_Onboarding_Form.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@alphamart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlphaMart onboarding — PO number + spend cap setup

Hi Amit — thanks for the form, looks straightforward. Short answers up front, then next steps:

- Purchase reference: we can issue a provisional purchase-ref (AMP-20260727-PR1) so your AP team can create the requisition. We will convert to a final PO number after the billing terms sign-off.
- Spend caps: we can set a quarterly spend cap flag at $75,000 in our billing system; increases require a one-email approval from AlphaMart procurement + our finance sign-off (same-day for small bumps, 48–72 hrs for >50%).
- Line-item mapping: we typically map subscription tiers to SKU codes (e.g., RDW-STD-TOKENS / RDW-PREMIUM-TOKENS) and then reconcile to token-bucket usage on invoices. I've attached our PO mapping template — please fill the "Requested Line" column and return.

Next steps:
1) Amit: drop the completed mapping in reply (po_mapping_template.csv).
2) Ben: can you provision AMP-20260727-PR1 as provisional ref and attach a provisional PO PDF? We'll then assign the spend cap flag and note the mapping pending final line edits.

If you want, I can loop in Karthik for faster spend-cap sign-off.

Thanks,
Priyom
Vendor Onboarding // Redwood Inference
attachments: po_mapping_template.csv

Looping in finance approvals and a small ask on line items.

Thanks for moving quickly. We reviewed the onboarding form and the provisional reference. Two requests before we finalize the official PO:

1) Line-item normalization 
   - Please ensure each requested line in the CSV has a numeric quantity and a unit price. Our invoicing system cannot accept free-text buckets. If you want, use the sample rows in column F of the template.

2) Spend-cap escalation path 
   - For increases up to 30% of the cap ($22.5k) we can approve via email from AlphaMart procurement. Anything beyond that requires a short internal review (we'll flag it but typically complete within 2 business days).

3) Provisional PO note: we'll keep AMP-20260727-PR1 active for 14 days; if we do not receive the mapping and the signed terms within that window we'll mark it stale and require reprovisioning.

Amit — once you reply with the completed po_mapping_template.csv (and the numeric quantities), I'll mark the provisional ref as "convert-to-final" and Ben will issue the final PO number.
